challenges.title: AI–human collaboration that produces a validated cancer hypothesis
challenges.body:
Develop a human-guided AI-agent team that generates a genuinely novel cancer hypothesis and a complete research plan capable of experimental validation.

Qualification gate: publish the system, prompts, provenance, and evaluation set; blinded experts must confirm novelty; a preregistered experiment must test a specific generated hypothesis; a qualified laboratory must validate the predicted result; and an unaffiliated group must independently reproduce it. Literature retrieval or an untested hypothesis alone does not qualify.

Safety gate: this is not medical advice. Human-subject work requires applicable IRB approval, informed consent, safety monitoring, data governance, trial registration, and regulatory authorization. Preclinical results must remain labeled preclinical.

source.label: Cancer Grand Challenges
source.caveat: Set in 2025; no team was funded and applications are closed. Tensor Book is independent and unaffiliated with Cancer Grand Challenges, Cancer Research UK, NCI, NIH, and FDA.

challenges.title: Measure the functional role of tumour-microenvironment dynamics over time
challenges.body:
Create a method that reveals the functional, longitudinal role of tumour-microenvironment interactions rather than producing another static spatial map.

Qualification gate: publish the method and a prespecified evaluation; use longitudinal human-derived evidence and causal perturbation in an appropriate, human-guided preclinical model; beat static or cross-sectional baselines; and validate independently on a second dataset or model. Correlation-only mapping does not qualify.

Safety gate: this is not medical advice. Human-subject work requires applicable IRB approval, informed consent, safety monitoring, data governance, trial registration, and regulatory authorization. Preclinical results must remain labeled preclinical.

challenges.title: Identify a causal mechanism of cancer avoidance in high-risk populations
challenges.body:
Identify a causal protective mechanism explaining why some high-risk or extremely aged populations remain cancer-free.

Qualification gate: replicate the association in an independent, adequately powered cohort; control for selection bias, survivor effects, risk-reducing interventions, ancestry, age, and exposure; establish functional evidence in an appropriate preclinical system; and obtain independent replication. An observational association alone does not qualify.

Safety gate: this is not medical advice. Human-subject work requires applicable IRB approval, informed consent, safety monitoring, data governance, trial registration, and regulatory authorization. Preclinical results must remain labeled preclinical.

challenges.title: Establish the cause of an unexplained cancer mutational signature
challenges.body:
Connect a previously unexplained mutational signature to a specific endogenous or environmental insult and establish the causal chain from insult to DNA damage to mutation.

Qualification gate: prespecify the signature; chemically identify the associated DNA lesion; reproduce the signature under controlled exposure; distinguish competing causes on held-out samples; and validate in an independent cohort or laboratory. Pattern matching without causal evidence does not qualify.

challenges.title: Rewire cancer cells into a less malignant state while sparing normal cells
challenges.body:
Demonstrate a novel way to redirect cancer-cell signalling toward a less malignant or self-defeating state while sparing normal cells.

Qualification gate: publish the mechanism and reproducible implementation; establish causal pathway evidence and cancer-versus-normal selectivity; demonstrate efficacy across heterogeneous and resistant preclinical models; assess off-target effects and toxicity; and obtain independent laboratory replication. Targeted protein degradation alone falls outside the source challenge’s stated scope.

challenges.title: Subquadratic exact associative recall at 64K tokens
challenges.body:
Build a causal sequence mixer that preserves attention-grade associative recall without quadratic all-pairs work.

Pass gate: train only through 4K tokens; evaluate hidden MQAR instances at 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K with 512 key-value pairs, 64 uniformly positioned queries, and vocabulary size 8,192. Mean exact match must be at least 99% at every length, with no seed below 98%. Code audit must show O(n log n) or better sequence mixing, O(n) memory, and no materialized n × n tensor. At 64K it must deliver at least 2× baseline prefill throughput and use at most 50% of baseline peak memory.

Leakage control: fresh keys, values, query positions, distractors, and token permutations are generated only after checkpoint freeze. Additional references: https://github.com/HazyResearch/zoology and https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.08691

source.label: Zoology / MQAR paper
source.caveat: This is a new Tensor Book benchmark contest, not a claim that the source paper offers or sponsors a prize.

challenges.title: Long-context reasoning without quadratic attention
challenges.body:
Beat dense self-attention on reasoning rather than only literal needle retrieval.

Pass gate: score one frozen model on hidden RULER multi-hop and aggregation tasks, BABILong QA2/QA3/QA7/QA8, and NoLiMa-Hard at 32K, 64K, and 128K. Its 4K macro score must be within one point of baseline; long-context macro score must exceed baseline by at least five absolute points with no benchmark family below baseline. At 128K it must provide at least 1.5× prefill throughput and use at most 60% of baseline peak memory.

Leakage control: exclude vanilla needle-in-a-haystack from the winning score; regenerate RULER and BABILong instances and paraphrase aliases after freeze; retain NoLiMa’s low-overlap requirement. Additional references: https://github.com/NVIDIA/RULER, https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.10149, and https://arxiv.org/abs/2502.05167

source.label: RULER benchmark paper
source.caveat: This is a new Tensor Book benchmark contest, not a claim that RULER, BABILong, or NoLiMa offers or sponsors a prize.

challenges.title: Bounded-memory one-pass streaming reasoning at one million tokens
challenges.body:
Process an indefinitely growing text stream once, answer questions online, and never reread raw history.

Pass gate: consume hidden BABILong QA1–QA10 streams in 4K-token chunks at 100K and 1M total tokens. Persistent model state may not exceed 16 MiB and the harness deletes each input chunk after processing. Mean exact accuracy must be at least 90% at both lengths, every task at least 80%, and the candidate must beat an equal-state 4K sliding-window Transformer by at least ten points. P95 latency per chunk in the final 10% of the stream may be no more than 1.10× the first 10%.

Leakage control: generate facts, questions, backgrounds, aliases, and query times after freeze; block and count network access, filesystem retrieval, raw-text caches, and recomputation from prior chunks.

source.label: BABILong benchmark
source.caveat: This is a new Tensor Book benchmark contest, not a claim that BABILong offers or sponsors a prize.

challenges.title: Sparse concept-address routing that causally generalizes
challenges.body:
Route computation through explicit, intervenable concept or construction addresses instead of opaque dense token-pair attention.

Pass gate: on regenerated COGS and SLOG splits, generalization exact match must exceed the matched Transformer by at least ten points on both datasets while in-distribution exact match remains within one point. Activate at most eight addresses per token or span on average, and keep at least 90% of sequence-mixing FLOPs free of dense all-pairs attention. On a hidden intervention set, replacing one construction address must produce the requested logical-form operation in at least 90% of cases while preserving unrelated argument slots in at least 95%.

Leakage control: freeze the address dictionary and concept-to-operation mapping before test; regenerate lexicons and structural combinations from official code; never expose generalization templates during training. Additional references: https://github.com/najoungkim/COGS, https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.15040, and https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.07992

source.label: COGS benchmark paper
source.caveat: This is a new Tensor Book benchmark contest, not a claim that COGS, SLOG, or Concept Bottleneck LLMs offers or sponsors a prize.

challenges.title: Formal-language and state-tracking length generalization
challenges.body:
Create one architecture that learns algorithmic state rather than memorizing training lengths.

Pass gate: train on lengths no greater than 40 in DeepMind’s Chomsky-hierarchy suite and no greater than 32 events in S5 permutation tracking. At hidden lengths 80, 160, 320, and 640, reach at least 99% exact accuracy on parity, cycle navigation, stack manipulation, reverse string, duplicate string, missing-duplicate string, and S5 composition; no seed may fall below 98%. Macro accuracy must beat the matched Transformer by at least 20 points and runtime must be O(n log n) or better. State and prove one fixed-parameter expressivity proposition under explicit precision and uniformity assumptions; empirical success alone is learnability, not a theorem.

Leakage control: generate unseen alphabets, object relabelings, operation encodings, and sequence lengths after freeze. Two independent reviewers check the proof and assumptions. Additional references: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.00208, https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.02854, and https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.08819

source.label: DeepMind Chomsky benchmark
source.caveat: This is a new Tensor Book benchmark contest, not a claim that the benchmark authors offer or sponsor a prize.

challenges.title: Real-language quality-and-efficiency Pareto win over self-attention
challenges.body:
Show that a proposed mixer is useful on natural language rather than only synthetic tasks.

Pass gate: train a 160M-active-parameter candidate and matched Transformer on the same fixed 5B-token Dolma/OLMo-style stream. Candidate Paloma macro bits per byte must be at least 1% lower, with no top-level domain family more than 1% worse. It must remain within one point of baseline on 4K RULER while, at 32K, delivering at least 1.5× prefill throughput, 1.25× decode throughput, and at most 60% of baseline runtime-state memory.

Leakage control: use Paloma’s fixed tokenizer and evaluation format plus subdocument decontamination controls; publish the full training manifest; add a hidden Paloma-style held-out corpus unavailable until checkpoint freeze. Additional references: https://allenai.org/olmo2, https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.10523, and https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.17844
